added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the rate-limit test does not exercise the ten-minute rate limit the plan's done-when names; the harness drives one pass per process, so the assertion len(snapshots)==1 holds for any single triggering pass and would stay true if the ten-minute guard were removed, so it re-asserts the D-state case rather than the limit it names.

follow-on: the change removes the file's terminating newline; the base blob ends the final line with a newline while the head ends it without one, and the new tests/test_fleet_health.py is likewise written without a trailing newline, against the repository's file hygiene.

justifications.fit: the change follows the FLEET_* variable and comment idiom of bin/fleet-health, but it drops that file's terminating newline (bin/fleet-health:123) and tests/test_fleet_health.py is written without one.
